summary: The argument is complete: positive area in all three singleton Q-cells yields three strict sign-pattern points whose normalized images contain the standard simplex, forcing A_2 to contain the full Q_{123} triangle. Its area is strictly larger than the maximal possible P_0 triangle because sigma=delta+2, so q_{123}>p_0. With Q_0 and R_0 forced empty, this makes W>0, contradicting W=0. The stated consequence follows immediately from the singleton product conclusion.
